_what: A made-up narration line for the tests and the README: `units` are said one generation each (a unit never splits a sentence; [word](/misaki IPA/) fixes one word for Kokoro, the other models get the plain word), `pause_after` is the silence after each unit in seconds, `inner_most` caps any silence the model makes inside a unit (an ellipsis), and `script` is the exact text. `hear_prompt` primes whisper with the names; `voice_reference` is the take each new take's speaker embedding is compared with. `vowel_check.word` is the one word whose vowel onset F2 measure_takes.py reports.
script: Close. The kettle is on... and the toast is burning. Aren't you, Morwenna?
units: The kettle is on... and the toast is burning.

vowel_check.expect: British GOAT /əʊ/: onset F2 about 1300-1500 Hz (American /oʊ/ about 900-1000 Hz)
